import Mathlib

example (n : ℕ) : n ≤ n + 1 ∧ n < n + 2 := by
  constructor <;> omega

example (a b : ℕ) (ha : a = 2) (hb : b = 3) : a + b = 5 ∧ a * b = 6 ∧ b - a = 1 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals subst ha hb
  all_goals rfl

example (p q r : Prop) (hp : p) (hq : q) (hr : r) : p ∧ q ∧ r := by
  repeat' constructor
  all_goals assumption
